attackers_goals: An attacker may be attempting to gain unauthorized access to user accounts.
description: An abnormally high amount of user account login attempts were seen from a host within a short period of time. This may have resulted from a login password spray attack.
investigative_actions: Check the amount of time in between each authentication attempt. Investigate the reason behind the login failures and if any accounts were locked out. Look for any successful authentication attempts and the ratio of login success versus login failures. Monitor for potential abuse of MFA on users who have successfully logged in.
